steps_bf2042-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your BF2042 mouse sensitivity from Settings → Mouse & Keyboard → Mouse Sensitivity. Note your soldier zoom sensitivity for each magnification.
steps_bf2042-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Choose the destination game. BF2042's vehicle gameplay and large maps mean sensitivity needs differ between infantry and vehicle combat.
steps_bf2042-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted value. Test in Portal mode or against bots to find your comfort zone before playing competitive multiplayer.
